definitions.gloss: silently; quietly and steadily; diligently without complaint
definitions.explanation: Working or doing something in silence, with steady focus and without complaining or chatting. Implies dedication and perseverance.

examples.japanese: {黙々|もくもく}と{働|はたら}いた。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{黙々|もくもく}と{食|た}べ{続|つづ}けた。
{職人|しょくにん}たちは{黙々|もくもく}と{作業|さぎょう}を{続|つづ}け、{夕方|ゆうがた}までに{全|すべ}ての{注文|ちゅうもん}を{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: The craftsmen worked away silently and finished all the orders by evening.

notes:
A taru-adjective/adverb from the repeated kanji {黙|もく} (silence). Almost always used in the adverbial form {黙々|もくもく}と.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黙々|もくもく}と{働|はたら}く (work silently)
- {黙々|もくもく}と{食|た}べる (eat in silence)
- {黙々|もくもく}と{歩|ある}く (walk silently)
- {黙々|もくもく}と{作業|さぎょう}する (work on a task silently)

USAGE:
Carries a positive connotation of diligence and quiet determination. Describes someone who gets things done without fuss or complaint. The と particle is required when using it adverbially. Often used to praise someone's work ethic or describe an admirable quality.
